<function name="Player" parent="Global" type="libraryfunc">
	<description>
Returns the player with the matching <page>Player:UserID</page>.

For a function that returns a player based on their <page>Entity:EntIndex</page>, see <page>Global.Entity</page>.


For a function that returns a player based on their connection ID, see <page>player.GetByID</page>.
	</description>
	<realm>Shared</realm>
	<args>
		<arg name="playerIndex" type="number">The player index.</arg>
	</args>
	<rets>
		<ret name="" type="Player">The retrieved player.</ret>
	</rets>
</function>
